text:
sara: opened a PR to add a compact guide on pricing slabs, rate smoothing behavior, an alert example, and short SDK snippets (node/python/curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2142

ben: thanks — can you include an axios example and call out the exact header format? people keep swapping `unit` vs `billing_unit`.

sara: added an axios snippet and standardized the column to `billing_unit`. canonical header we show: `X-Redwood-Meter: tenant=acme;billing_unit=tokens;amount=1024`

oliver: small ask: include a 1-row CSV sample and a note about ISO8601 UTC timestamps. timezone mismatches make dashboards look empty during reviews.

sara: included CSV row in PR description: `2026-05-01T00:00:00Z,acme,generation,1024` and one-line sqlite import command.

mei: also add a short PromQL and an example Alertmanager rule so platform teams can copy alerts for slab breaches.

sara: added PromQL and Alertmanager example. PromQL for the slab panel: ```promql
sum(increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total{tier!="free"}[1h])) by (tier)
```

Alertmanager snippet in the PR: ```yaml
- alert: BillingSlabBreach
  expr: sum(increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total[1h])) by (tier) > 100000
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Usage spike for {{ $labels.tier }}"
```

ben: perfect. also include a short paragraph about rate smoothing: our rate limiter smooths bursts into a moving window, so the "effective rate" panel should use `rate()` or `increase()` depending on the expected signal.

sara: added a short note: use `rate()` for live per-second SLOs, use `increase()` for billing aggregates. provided example PromQL for effective rate: ```promql
avg(rate(redwood_rate_limiter_credits_total[5m])) by (tenant)
```

oliver: one UX nit: rename panel title to "Billing units (1h, by tier)" to match the PromQL window.

sara: updated panel title and added a short FAQ: "Why does my billed tokens count differ from request count?" Answer: tokens != requests; model context + response tokens contribute.

ben: can we show a Node axios snippet? I'll paste it in the PR if you want.

sara: added this Node example in the docs: ```js
// server-side only (do not expose keys in frontend)
const axios = require('axios')
await axios.post('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/usage', { timestamp: '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z', route: '/v1/generate', tokens: 1024 }, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'X-Redwood-Meter': 'tenant=acme;billing_unit=tokens;amount=1024', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }})
```

Also included a tiny python/requests and curl example.

mei: thanks. quick migration reminder: older SDKs used `X-Redwood-Quota` header — added a one-line converter snippet in the migration section.

infra-bot: preview build for PR #2142 started (linkcheck, lint, accessibility).

docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-2142--docs.redwood.ai/ (includes Grafana import JSON link)

ben: LGTM after preview check. thanks for keeping it compact and including alert rules.

sara: merging after checks pass. will follow up with localized snippets (es, ja) in a follow-up PR.

docs-bot: PR #2142 merged by sara. Release note: "metering: pricing slab guide, smoothing notes, alert example, SDK snippets and demo CSV"
